contract.name: Core V3 - Conserved N/U Algebraic-Pressure DAE Contract
contract.storage_definition: For each lower pressure-owning volume, U[j] = NL[j] * (hL(T[j],P[j],x[j]) - P[j]/rhoL(T[j],P[j],x[j])). Top U is derived on its fixed-pressure bubble manifold.
contract.energy_balance_definition: Lower dU[j]/dt equals the exact enthalpy-flow balance. The top energy balance uses the exact fixed-pressure saturation-manifold dU_top/dN gradient; no timestep or moving-pressure gradient is used.
contract.pressure_definition: P[reflux_drum] is fixed; four lower pressures are simultaneous algebraic unknowns. The terminal reboiler/sump return uses dry resistance only; three physical tray links use dry resistance plus liquid head.
contract.index_claim: property-free square implicit-index-1 candidate; live leading-Jacobian and constraint-manifold rank remain unclaimed
